item.text: The conversion path currently uses a shared renderer that disables list parsing, while URL placeholders live in global maps without an owner. I’m updating the renderer to accept configurable disabled rules, fixing cleanup/nesting, and carrying a message identity through generation, result rendering, and editor insertion.
